calls.content:
I answered from the facts in the task packet and did not call any tools. I didn't run recall_facts, so I'm relying on the packet's copy of my memory.

**q1 (price):** Two facts conflict. o7_price says £12.00, observed 2026-09-20. price_o7 says £13.50, observed 2026-09-29. The later one is newer and comes from the same listing URL, so I use **£13.50**.

**q2 (fee):** Two facts conflict here too. stallhub_fee_rate says 6.5%, observed 2026-09-20. fee_rate_stallhub says 9%, observed 2026-10-01. The 9% fact is newer and comes from the dedicated fees page, so I use **9%**.

**q3 (printed unit cost):** Only one fact covers this, printing_cost at £2.00, so I use **£2.00**. It is the PrintCo list price and was observed on 2026-09-20.

**q4 (bundle margin):** The £15 bundle contains 2 printed units.
- The Stallhub fee is 9% of £15, which is £1.35.
- Printing costs 2 × £2.00 = £4.00.
- Net margin is £15 − £1.35 − £4.00 = **£9.65**.

ANSWERS: q1=13.50; q2=9; q3=2.00; q4=9.65
